future_check: Revisit the grammar only if new canonical evidence introduces nonzero backgrounds, overlapping pluses, or more than two simultaneous triggers.
rationale: All four canonical pairs use a zero background and separated pluses. This keeps demonstrations identifiable and prevents accidental overlapping-trigger ambiguity, but arbitrary palette permutations that move color 0 are not lawful augmentations.
summary: The teaching grammar intentionally assumes color 0 is background and allows at most two separated triggers.

future_check: Keep the rival witnesses disjoint from never-train probes and verify them through harvest_rule_adversaries whenever the generator grammar changes.
rationale: Each alternative fits the first three canonical demonstrations, so code reading and canonical parity alone do not distinguish it. Executable rivals were verified against those demos and killed by dedicated generated witnesses.
summary: Bounding-box completion, color-blind crosses, one-trigger-per-color, and boundary skipping are not the task rule.

future_check: Re-run the 32-start sliding-window audit whenever profile order, EXAMPLES_NEEDED, or scene-profile defaults change.
rationale: The canonical pairs alone are simultaneously fit by several shortcuts. Clean anchors preserve canonical morphology, while one L distractor, one mixed-color false cross, and a repeated-color boundary case each isolate a different local-rule requirement. A four-sample cycle makes every consecutive four-demo lesson contain all profiles.
summary: Use a cyclic four-profile lesson instead of sampling only clean pluses.

future_check: If authority roles change or the archival source becomes active, require exact synchronization before promotion.
rationale: The baseline oracle passed 120 real applications, and both before and after authority audits found one exact active-source group. The divergent raw source is explicitly archival and still passed execution parity, so editing it would create unnecessary source churn.
summary: No Racket patch was warranted; the canonical oracle was already correct and active authorities were synchronized.
